_about: The exact values src/lib/league-config.ts should be changed to, based on the authenticated ESPN pull of league 441239. Machine-readable companion to data/espn-reconciliation.md. ANOTHER AGENT APPLIES THESE - this file does not edit anything.

_evidenceKey.espn-2026: Read directly from ESPN league 441239, season 2026, authenticated.
_evidenceKey.espn-history: Also identical in ESPN seasons 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 - a five-season-stable setting, not a typo.
_evidenceKey.none: No evidence found anywhere. Still a placeholder; needs the commissioner.

changes.detail: lineupSlotCounts slot 20 (Bench) = 7, in all of 2022-2026. Also confirmed by the 'Roster' sheet in 2026 DRAFT.xlsx (7 BENCH rows). The Smart Draft room's BN:5 is WRONG. Sanity check: 9 starters + 7 bench = 16 roster spots = exactly the 16 draft rounds, which only works with 7.
9 starters + 7 bench. IR sits outside the active cap.
settings.rosterSettings.positionLimits, keyed by ESPN position id: 1=QB:4, 2=RB:8, 3=WR:9, 4=TE:3, 5=K:0, 16=D/ST:3. Note this changes the field's type from string to object.
settings.draftSettings.timePerSelection = 90. Advisory only, since the draft is offline - but 90 is what ESPN is set to.
settings.tradeSettings.revisionHours = 48. ESPN's own preset default is 24, so 48 is a deliberate league choice. Trades are NOT instant in this league.

settings.tradeSettings.deadlineDate = 2026-11-20T08:00:00Z, which is midnight Pacific / 02:00 Central on Fri Nov 20 2026. The 2026 NFL season opens Thu Sep 10, so week 11 runs Nov 19-23 and week 12 starts Nov 26. The deadline therefore falls inside week 11.
changes.confirmFirst: Ask the commissioner whether he means week 11. The deadline currently lands mid-week-11, after the Thursday night game but before Sunday, which is an odd place for it. If he wants end of week 12, the ESPN setting needs moving, not this file.

correct.note: SIX points, not the standard four

changes.callout: PASSING TD = 6 IS THE BIG ONE. It is not ESPN's default (4) and nothing in the repo had it. It materially raises QB value, so any ranking or ADP built assuming 4-point passing TDs understates quarterbacks for this league.

correct.note: Applies to interception, fumble, kickoff and punt return TDs, and blocked kick / punt / PAT returns

It is probably deliberate: ESPN's own preset ships isUsingAcquisitionBudget = false, so someone switched it on. Ask the commissioner whether waivers are FAAB-bid or rolling-order.

suggestedNewExports.detail: scheduleSettings.playoffTeamCount 6, playoffMatchupPeriodLength 1, playoffReseed false, playoffSeedingRule TOTAL_POINTS_SCORED. Six teams over three one-week rounds means the top two seeds get a first-round bye.
